Rivals & ghosts

Your past laps become the opposition.

Race your recordings

Ordinary TURN rivals are saved recordings of your own fastest laps. POSITION compares you with them; BEST is your record. Better laps replace older rivals.

Read the track sheet

Open a track in ROADBOOK to inspect its records and rivals before racing. Different tracks keep their own history.

Learn from the gap

Notice where a rival gains time. Watch that run in SPECTATE, then practise the section yourself. A ghost shows a repeatable reference rather than a live opponent.

Reset deliberately

RESET RIVALS removes recorded rivals for the selected track. Use it when you want fresh opposition, not as a routine step after a bad lap.
